name: node
meaning: index of the path point it moves toward (FrozenRiver_FindNextNode 0x4c353b; ++ at 0x4c3a06)

name: moving
meaning: 1 while it moves toward node; 0 while another cargo holds that node (FrozenRiver_IsNodeTaken, 0x4c355a/0x4c3569, 0x4c37f3)

name: active
meaning: floe slots: 1 while the floe is in the water (FrozenRiver_LaunchFloe 0x4c3d5a), 0 once the crane has it (0x4c30d4); the cargo slots only clear it (0x4c31d3)

name: obj
meaning: the Wolf, the Sheep or the SlidingIceCube (0x4c3523, 0x4c35ba, 0x4c2bbb)

name: waitingCrane
meaning: 1 once the crane has been sent msg 0x37 for it at the last node (0x4c3b2a); MoveCargo then does nothing more for it

name: done
meaning: 1 once the crane has taken it (msg 0x3e, 0x4c3039/0x4c310b); FrozenRiver_UpdateCargo skips it
